description:
Other polygons for Event, State of Palestine, 7 January 2015 (ST20150107PSE): 2,784 features merged from 3 source layers. Polygons layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Snow cover extent over West Bank, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-snow-cover-extent-over-west-bank-israel-jordan-lebanon-and-syria-january-12-2015)
- [Geodata of Snow cover extent over West Bank, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon and Syria](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-snow-cover-extent-over-west-bank-israel-jordan-lebanon-and-syria-january-13-2015)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.
